args.question: Please provide the cardholder statement and any communication with the cardholder about this transaction.

args.narrative: The order was authorized (auth code 571225) and a receipt for 113.80 USD was issued on 2026-01-05. USPS delivery proof shows the order was delivered on 2026-01-10. The cardholder states they cancelled and were still charged. The merchant holds no cancellation record for this order, and the delivery proof does not address the cancellation claim.

args.explanation: Chargeback 13.1 on USD 113.80 (seed 6002). Read the case, the ledger and the three evidence documents (receipt, authorization record, USPS delivery proof dated 2026-01-10). The cardholder said they cancelled and were still charged. I represented on 2026-02-22 with the receipt, authorization and delivery proof, and stated that I hold no cancellation record. The issuer accepted the representment on 2026-03-04 and the chargeback was reversed. The merchant keeps the funds and paid the 15.00 USD chargeback fee. Deadlines were met.
